_comment: Search-result copy. A title is cut at ~60 characters and a description at ~160, while an npm description is not cut at all — so these are written separately from package.json. The site generator appends ' | TronLess' to every title; keep the text here under 49 characters. Checked by scripts/check-packages.mjs.

index.title: TRON developer tools: energy, TRC-20, addresses
index.description: Eleven free MIT-licensed Node.js tools for TRON developers: address validation, SUN/TRX units, offline keygen, energy fee calculator, TRC-20 decoding.

tron-address.title: TRON address validator and converter
tron-address.description: Validate any TRON or TRC-20 address by its real checksum and convert Base58 (T…) to hex (41…) or EVM 0x form. CLI and library, no tronweb needed.

tron-units.title: SUN to TRX converter and TRC-20 decimals
tron-units.description: Convert SUN to TRX and back and format TRC-20 token amounts with BigInt-safe parseUnits and formatUnits. USDT TRC-20 ready, zero dependencies.

tron-client.title: TRON HTTP client for Node.js (TronGrid)
tron-client.description: Minimal zero-dependency HTTP client for TronGrid and TRON full nodes: mainnet, Nile and Shasta presets, API key support, timeouts, retry on limits.

tron-keygen.title: Offline TRON wallet and address generator
tron-keygen.description: Generate a TRON private key and address offline, derive accounts from a BIP-39 mnemonic at m/44'/195'/0'/0/n, search vanity addresses. No network.

tron-energy-calculator.title: TRON energy and USDT TRC-20 fee calculator
tron-energy-calculator.description: Work out what a USDT TRC-20 transfer costs in energy, bandwidth and TRX, including the new-recipient surcharge, and compare renting against burning.

tron-account-resources.title: Check TRON energy and bandwidth of an address
tron-account-resources.description: Read energy, bandwidth, staked TRX and delegated resources for any TRON address, and see how many USDT transfers the balance actually covers.

trc20-decoder.title: TRC-20 calldata and event log decoder
trc20-decoder.description: Decode TRC-20 calldata and event logs from raw TronGrid JSON: transfer, approve and transferFrom, Transfer and Approval events, function selectors.

trc20-token.title: Get a USDT TRC-20 balance, no private key
trc20-token.description: Read any TRC-20 token on TRON without a private key: balanceOf, allowance, name, symbol, decimals and total supply via triggerconstantcontract.

tron-tx-inspector.title: TRON transaction and fee breakdown lookup
tron-tx-inspector.description: Look up any TRON transaction by hash: status, block, sender, recipient, decoded TRC-20 method and a full breakdown of energy, bandwidth and burn.

tron-rpc-health.title: TRON RPC endpoints and node health check
tron-rpc-health.description: Measure latency, block height and lag across TronGrid, TronStack and public TRON nodes on mainnet, Nile and Shasta, and pick the fastest endpoint.

tron-address-watcher.title: USDT TRC-20 deposit notifications for TRON
tron-address-watcher.description: Watch TRON addresses for incoming USDT TRC-20 and TRX transfers and get events or webhooks, with de-duplication and no full node to run yourself.
